summary: E-2 Alembic main consumer package after accepted AlembicAgent producer commit 1b8d5009da34613272ce93112589897515649d74. Scope is ONLY ToolContextFactory consumer wiring for live terminal.exec safety: (1) E2-6 inject auditSink from the existing single DI factory so daemon/HTTP/CLI tool calls all receive the same audit logger path; (2) E2-7 preserve sandboxExec diagnostics through SandboxExecutorBridge so Agent terminal.exec can expose sandbox fallback/degradation. Current evidence: Alembic/lib/tools/v2/ToolContextFactory.ts create() already builds ToolContext for V2 tools but lacks auditSink, and SandboxExecutorBridge.exec() returns only stdout/stderr/exitCode, dropping sandboxExec result.sandboxed/result.degradeReason. Implement narrowly in Alembic: add auditSink: tryGet(c,'auditLogger') in ToolContextFactory.create(); extend SandboxExecutorBridge return shape to include diagnostics compatible with AlembicAgent's accepted contract {sandboxed:boolean,fallbackUsed:boolean,degradeReason?:string}; map sandboxExec result.sandboxed=false to fallbackUsed:true and carry degradeReason, and sandboxed=true to fallbackUsed:false. Do not change command policy, sandbox profile, filesystem/network intent, command execution semantics, Agent repository, Core, Plugin, E-1 Evolution terminal access, E-3 dead stack deletion/public subpath, E-4 phantom cleanup, or E-5 prompts. Add/adjust tests around ToolContextFactory/V2 tool system proving auditSink comes from container auditLogger and SandboxExecutorBridge/terminal.exec output can surface degraded diagnostics when sandboxExec reports sandboxed:false. If direct bridge unit seams are hard because of dynamic imports, add the smallest testable seam without broad refactor; avoid mock-only success with no real consumer. Validate with Node >=22: npm run build:check, relevant unit tests, lint:repo-boundary, and if touched shared assets then check:shared-asset-drift. Commit on Alembic main and return TargetResultEnvelope with commit hash, changed files, validation outputs, and residual risks.
